label: Expo Lexi runtime and presentation
failure_mode: Degrade visual effects first, then optional enrichment. Never fabricate evidence or make the lexical answer unreadable because an effect or optional integration failed.
invariants: Runtime ranks and renders canonical evidence; it does not author reusable linguistic truth.
Approved evidence may present as Lexi; candidate evidence remains Gef/provisional.
Lesson actions are gated through canonical trigger, directional readiness and release rules.
Persistent DustFlow remains the only particle/GL background; UI styling never enters linguistic annotations.
Legacy adapter vocabulary is normalized to canonical typed refs before lesson matching or presentation.
